title: dedupe_and_rank input
description: Input for dedupe_and_rank (MOD-10, MOD-12): group items by greedy representative clustering in input order at `threshold`, then rank the group REPRESENTATIVES against `query` by cosine in one embedding pass. The implementation enforces what JSON Schema cannot express alone: item ids must be unique, and `top_k` must not exceed the number of group representatives actually produced (one group per distinct near-duplicate cluster), because returning fewer rows would be indistinguishable from having ranked fewer groups. The query is a named second position, so its id is deliberately not compared with the item ids.

items.description: The items in the caller's order; that order determines representatives and tie outcomes (MOD-12). Each item is embedded exactly once.

query.description: The query embedded once, in the same pass and the same space as the items, then scored against the group representatives (MOD-10).

threshold.description: The cosine similarity at or above which two items belong to one group (MOD-12). The contract admits the open interval (-1, 1), the same as semantic_deduplicate.

top_k.description: How many group representatives to return, best first. It must not exceed the number of representatives actually produced; the implementation refuses that rather than returning fewer rows or clamping (MOD-10). Defaults to every representative.

dimensions.description: The width the items and the query are embedded at (MOD-04). All of them share one width and one space.

mediaPart.description: One part of an item, as a closed discriminated union on `kind` (MOD-06).
